m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: You will not treat with whom, poxy knight? I have brought the Horned Crown that Lady Morganthe requested.
It is potent magic of darkness and Shadow. You have my reward?
Do what I say, and Artorius will fall. I have no patience to watch the people suffer while he dithers.
I gazed upon the Divining Treasure and it showed me the land will wither under his rule. The old way, the old king, is gone.
This toothless bear lets too many foes nip at his heels. The people need a new, strong sword to follow.
Once I sabotage his armor, the next friendly duel he accepts will be his last.
<ITALICS>If only Malory would see there is another way. The Froudling magic holds the key to getting what we want, without hurting anybody. </ITALICS>
You are a meeting a Spriggan here? I will not treat with those dishonorable savages.
Foul creature, your reward will be my blade!
Are you recovered from the first dream?
Morganthe, are you listening to me?
You betray our pact! May your victory turn to ashes!
Morganthe, take the Horned Crown and hide it away. I must go and ensure Artorius' armor is not fit for battle.
If, for whatever reason, my plan is spoiled, then you must use the Horned Crown to enslave the king.
<ITALICS>Brother, if your plan goes awry, I could not live on in Avalon without you. </ITALICS>
<ITALICS>The Horned Crown contains a power I've not encountered in any of Merle Ambrose's teachings. It twists and turns by itself. </ITALICS>
<ITALICS>I wonder if Ambrose has any theory of it inscribed in his tomes of Forbidden Knowledge. </ITALICS>
Go, little sister, and prepare. I will see you when all of this is done and but a memory.
Enter the first Chamber of the Mind. You will see and hear one of Morganthe's earliest memories.
Remember, these are true things, but colored by how she remembers them.
Enter the first Chamber of the Mind and experience Morganthe's dream.
